verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a project-management and team-communication SaaS. It does not author or push git commits, so signing AI-authored commits with SSH/GPG keys is outside its product category. Its AI-agent support (MCP, CLI, skills) works on Basecamp resources such as to-dos and messages, not source-control commits, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can require AI-authored commits to be cryptographically signed with my SSH or GPG key
